description: Add a runnable end-to-end verification script under scripts/ that, GIVEN real credentials in env, executes ONE complete real transaction against the real Shopify test store + real Razorpay test API and prints each step plus the final signed receipt. Gated so it only runs when real creds are present and exits 0 gracefully (skip) otherwise. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Add scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs (ESM, matches scripts/run-db-lifecycle.mjs style). At top, if required real creds missing (SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN/SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN, RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) print 'SKIPPED: real credentials not present' and process.exit(0). Never print secret values.

The script imports BUILT connector/worker code (package entrypoints @counter/shopify-connector, @counter/razorpay-adapter, @counter/payment-sdk, @counter/worker) so it exercises the SAME wiring the worker uses. Header documents that `pnpm build` must run first. Reuse FEAT-003 lifecycle wiring / connector factories rather than re-implementing.

Execute one real transaction end to end, printing each labeled step with the real identifiers: (1) Shopify connectivity (shop name / a released product+variant); (2) create REAL Shopify draft order, print draftOrderId + name; (3) create REAL Razorpay test order via POST /v1/orders, print order id (order_...); (4) run the unattended payment via CounterTestPaymentProvider, print typed signed provider evidence (status, reference); (5) finalize Shopify order + mark as paid (REAL), print orderId + financial status; (6) query the order back (REAL) as authoritative evidence; (7) reconcile and print intended vs provider amount; (8) print the FINAL signed receipt (CTP-signed envelope). Redact secrets; print only references, amounts, statuses, signed receipt.

Use a small INR amount and a real released variant (query catalog to pick one, or SHOPIFY_TEST_VARIANT_GID env override). Use a unique transaction/idempotency key per run but STABLE within the run. After the run, optionally cancel/refund to leave the store clean (best-effort, clearly labeled).
Add root package.json script "verify:real": "node scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs" runnable via pnpm verify:real. Running WITHOUT creds prints SKIPPED and exits 0.
Do NOT add this to default pnpm test/build/CI-critical path in a way requiring creds. Confirm pnpm test count still >= 2731 and depcruise clean after adding.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs exists and is invokable via pnpm verify:real.
Without real creds it prints SKIPPED and exits 0 (verified in this credential-less sandbox).
With real creds it runs one complete real transaction (real Shopify draft+order+mark-paid+query, real Razorpay order) and prints each labeled step plus the final signed receipt, printing NO secrets.
Adding the script does not change the test baseline and depcruise stays clean.
verification: node scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs (expect SKIPPED, exit 0 when no creds)
findings: Added scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs (ESM) and root package.json script 'verify:real'. The script gates on real creds via the worker's resolveShopifyCredentials/resolveRazorpayCredentials; when any Shopify/Razorpay cred is missing it prints 'SKIPPED: real credentials not present' and exits 0. It does NOT re-implement the lifecycle: it uses the worker's own selectPaymentAuthorizationPort (real mode) and drives it through createTransactionLifecycleHandler with a capturing ReceiptSink, so the exact FEAT-003 money seam runs (steps 2-8 happen inside authorizeAndCapture). Step 1 (connectivity + released variant pick, honoring SHOPIFY_TEST_VARIANT_GID override) and step 6 authoritative OrderQuery + best-effort orderCancel cleanup use the same createShopifyConnectorFromConfig connector. Each labeled step prints only real ids/amounts/statuses parsed from the providerReference (pay:...|shopify_order:...|razorpay_order:...) plus the final receipt; no secrets logged. IMPORT MECHANISM: root is NOT a pnpm workspace member and @counter/* are not symlinked into root node_modules, so bare specifiers do not resolve from scripts/. The script therefore imports the BUILT dist entrypoints by path (apps/worker/dist/index.js, packages/shopify-connector/dist/index.js, packages/domain/dist/index.js); each dist entrypoint resolves its own transitive @counter/* from its package node_modules. `pnpm build` is a documented prerequisite. Not added to the default test/build/CI path. VERIFIED: pnpm build ok; node scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs prints SKIPPED and exits 0 in this credential-less sandbox; pnpm test = 2758 passed (baseline unchanged); pnpm depcruise clean (2071 modules); prettier+eslint clean on the new file. SANDBOX NOTE confirmed: fs_write/read_file/grep_search hit a stale overlay and did NOT reach the real disk; the file was authored via bash heredoc and verified on disk with bash grep.
